title: Funds Tracker
description: A full-stack web application for my trading card business that tracks transactions, manages funds, and coordinates financial activity across multiple team members. Firebase provides real-time synchronization for transaction history and account balances.

title: AI Note Sheet
description: A web-based note-taking application with lightweight text styling and AI-powered summarization. The interface helps organize notes while generating concise summaries for easier reading and information retrieval.

title: Simple Unix Shell
description: A Unix shell written in C++ to replicate key features of a modern command-line interface. It includes an interactive prompt, command parsing, process forking, background job management, and built-in commands, completed for my operating systems course at WPI.

title: Hand Gesture Canvas
description: A computer vision application that uses webcam-based hand gesture recognition to create a hands-free digital drawing interface. MediaPipe provides real-time hand tracking and gesture classification for drawing, color selection, and clearing the canvas.
